headline: Recommended approval of zone change for NS Fernbank Road, 6-0, from Residence B and Business A to Residence C.
summary: A public hearing covered Zone Change #3266 for NS Fernbank Road. One person spoke in favor and none spoke against. Members voted 6-0 to recommend approval of the change from Residence B and Business A to Residence C.
decisions: Recommended approval of Zone Change #3266 at NS Fernbank Road, changing Residence B and Business A to Residence C, by a 6-0 vote.
